name: Jazz duo for a cocktail hour: Autumn Leaves on guitar and upright bass
seoTitle: Jazz duo for a cocktail hour: Autumn Leaves
description: Here's the jazz duo playing Autumn Leaves on guitar and upright bass, at a volume that suits a cocktail hour. Book the duo for jazz standards as guests arrive.
more: Autumn Leaves is one of the jazz standards on our song list, along with The Girl from Ipanema, Fly Me to the Moon, Misty and Take the A Train. You can book the duo for a single hour or for the first few hours of your event. If you'd like dancing later on, we can add a band for that part.
